h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ratlam

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ratlam

items.pText: Ratlam is a major railway junction on the Malwa plateau in western Madhya Pradesh, and its namkeen is known across India. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to schools, housing societies, railway colonies and public gardens here. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 490 km away, and the equipment travels to Ratlam by road.

Older colonies in Ratlam often have a garden that once had play equipment and now needs replacing. Before ordering new pieces, look at why the old ones failed. Rusted joints, cracked footings and pieces placed too close together are common causes. Send us photos of the existing area with its size, and we will propose a layout with proper safe zones and footings that suit the soil.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Black soil and foundations in Ratlam

c: Much of Malwa sits on black cotton soil, which swells when it soaks up monsoon rain and shrinks and cracks in the dry months. Footings laid straight into this soil can shift over time and leave posts leaning. For grouted equipment, dig footings deeper and bed them on a compacted layer of murrum or gravel. Ask your local civil contractor to confirm the depth for your plot.
On a finished paved surface, a self-standing frame avoids digging altogether. Either way, cover the play area with rubber flooring rather than bare soil. For nearby cities, see our pages for

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: We have old play equipment. Can you replace it?
items.a: Yes. Send photos and the size of the area, and tell us what is already on site. We will suggest new equipment and a fresh layout, and let you know what needs to be cleared before installation.

items.q: Do you supply railway colonies and institutions?
items.a: Yes. We work with schools, societies, colonies and public bodies. For institutions we provide a layout drawing and a detailed quote that can go through your approval process.
We strongly recommend an impact-absorbing surface under swings, slides and climbers. Rubber flooring cushions falls, stays usable after rain and is easier to keep clean than soil or gravel.
